profile.headline: Software Engineering at The Aerospace Corporation

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a feature toggle web application using React + NextJS in the front-end and Spring + Hibernate + MySQL in the back-end.
• Designed and implemented a mobile application that provides detailed information about corporate locations and employees using React + Ionic + Capacitor.
• Implemented new features and fixed bugs in production codes on a large-scale corporate web application using React + Redux in the front-end and NodeJS + MongoDB + MySQL in the back-end.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Conducted research alongside Dr. David Lee in exploring the intersection of computational systems and social interaction.
•  Developed Angular web applications from Figma hi-fidelity design mockups using HTML, SCSS, and TypeScript in an Agile environment.
• Conducted platform usability tests and analyzed user feedback to streamline product bug-fixed and simplify core learning hierarchy.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and deployed company responsive website.
• Integrated website with a payment gateway to accept donations and payments.
• Collaborated in a team of 6 people to create a digital archive with all news articles since 1929.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Worked closely with the design and development teams to create and maintain websites for companies such as Southern California Edison, San Gabriel Valley Water Company, Toluca Lake City Council.
• Implemented payment forms on various websites with payment gateways and jQuery.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Integrated clients' websites with various functionalities using HTML, CSS, JavaScrip, jQuery and PHP
• Developed responsive and user friendly websites for clients
